title: daily-scratchpad-gpu-ops
content:
Daily scratchpad - GPU ops & infra reminders (notes to self)

2026-03-04 (last updated)

Morning health checks:
- quick kubectl get nodes: all Ready except one preemptible-west-1a (PendingNotReady) -> ticket INFRA-1087
- nvidia-smi across pools: g5-pool average 78% util, g4-pool 92% (some pods pegged)
- check autoscaler alerts: cpu/gpu-scaling triggered x3 overnight in eu-west

Top priority TODOs:
1) Capacity forecast for Dedicated pools (monthly) - include planned customer commits for Q2
   - action: run latest capacity script (scripts/capacity-forecast.py) and refresh spreadsheet
   - target: update sheet + slack summary by EOD Fri
   - linked: JIRA INFRA-1023

2) Investigate g4-pool high utilization (pods stuck in Pending)
   - hypothesis: kube-scheduler binpacking + taints on new nodes
   - quick checks: describe pod, check node taints, check nfs mount latency
   - temp mitigation: cordon one old g4 node and drain low-priority batch jobs
   - follow-up: open PR to adjust scheduler priority for batch jobs if repeat (see github PR stub)

3) GPU driver/driver-container upgrade on staging (g5-staging)
   - current: driver 525.x, want to test 550.x (perf + CUDA 12 compatibility)
   - plan: image build -> canary deploy to 2 nodes -> run perf smoke (latency + memory)
   - assign: Marcus to build image, me to run perf tests

4) NVLink / multi-GPU checks on dedicated-raid nodes
   - note: reported intermittent ECC errors on node ded-12 last week
   - run nvidia-health-check + collect dmesg logs, attach to INFRA-1023 if hardware issue

5) Network egress cost spike investigation for private-deployments region us-east-2
   - check VPC flow logs for cross-AZ transfers
   - verify routing table changes around 2026-02-28 (customer rollout window)
   - if confirmed, schedule meeting with networking (Lina)

Operational reminders / quick notes:
- Reconcile autoscaler config: minPoolSizes vs committedCapacity (dedicated) - mismatch observed
- Monthly reserved GPU inventory: update procurement plan if forecast delta > 10%
- Rotate KMS keys for private deployment test cluster next Tue (coord with security)
- TTL for ephemeral GPU nodes: reduce from 30m -> 20m for batch workloads to reduce cost

Checks to run today (short list):
- run capacity-forecast.py --range Q2 (output to sheet)
- kubectl describe pod <pending-pod> in g4-pool and paste events into INFRA-1087
- collect nvidia-smi top output (timestamped) and upload to /shared/logs/gpu-metrics/2026-03-04
- run NVLink diag on ded-12 (sudo nvidia-smi nvlink --status)
- check k8s node NTP drift across eu clusters (search for >500ms)

Notes to self / brainstorm:
- Could try bursting low-priority workloads into cheaper preemptible pools with aggressive checkpointing to save cost. Need runbook + automated checkpoint sidecar (prototype?).
- Consider per-customer routing policy to push non-latency-sensitive inference to quantized model variants during peak hours (tie into Optimize recommendations).

Unresolved questions / blockers:
- Why did autoscaler spin up 4 nodes at 03:12 but pods remained Pending? Need scheduler logs around that time (kube-scheduler, cloud-provider).
- Does our kubelet eviction threshold need tuning for gpu memory pressure? Some batch pods show OOM on GPUs (OOMKill not visible in container logs).

Slack refs: #infra-gpu (pin the capacity sheet), #private-deployments (notify re: KMS rotation)
Confluence: GPU Capacity Playbook (refresh section on preemptible strategy)

Small wins to log in daily update:
- fixed node labeling bug for z2 region yesterday (reverted bad taint)
- autoscaler rule for g5-pool reduced cost by 6% in last billing cycle (yay)

End of notes. Keep short TODOs in task manager after triage.
